name: JavaScript
description: From browser scripting to full-stack development with Node.js.

challenges.iniciante: Create a function that reverses a string without using the built-in reverse() method.
challenges.intermediario: Build a promise-based function that fetches a list of users from a public API and returns only those whose names start with the letter 'A'.
challenges.avancado: Implement a debounce utility using closures and demonstrate its use in an event listener scenario. Include unit tests.

name: Python
description: General-purpose language beloved for scripting, data science and AI.

challenges.iniciante: Write a Python function that counts the frequency of each word in a given sentence and returns a dictionary sorted by frequency.
challenges.intermediario: Create a class `Stack` that uses a list internally and supports push, pop, peek and is_empty operations. Write pytest tests for each method.
challenges.avancado: Implement an asynchronous web scraper using asyncio and aiohttp that fetches titles from 10 URLs concurrently and saves results to a JSON file.

name: React
description: Component-based UI library for building modern web interfaces.

modules: Form management with React Hook Form
Context API vs Zustand vs Redux Toolkit

challenges.iniciante: Build a simple counter component that increments, decrements and resets, displaying the current value.
challenges.intermediario: Create a custom useFetch hook that accepts a URL, manages loading/error/data states and returns them to the consuming component.
challenges.avancado: Architect a paginated list feature using React Query (TanStack Query) with infinite scroll, skeleton loaders and error boundaries.

name: Node.js
description: Server-side JavaScript runtime built on Chrome's V8 engine.

modules: Database access with Prisma or Mongoose

challenges.iniciante: Create a Node.js script that reads a directory path from command-line arguments and prints the names of all files in that directory.
challenges.intermediario: Build an Express REST API with CRUD endpoints for a 'tasks' resource, storing data in-memory (no database required). Include input validation.
challenges.avancado: Design and implement a rate-limiter middleware using the sliding-window algorithm backed by an in-memory store, with unit tests covering edge cases.

name: TypeScript
description: Typed superset of JavaScript for large-scale application development.

modules: Utility types (Partial, Required, Pick, Omit, Record)

challenges.iniciante: Define a TypeScript interface for a `Product` with id, name, price and optional discount. Write a function that applies the discount and returns the final price.
challenges.intermediario: Create a generic `Repository<T>` class with findById, findAll, save and delete methods, typed so that each method enforces the correct entity shape.
challenges.avancado: Implement a type-safe event emitter using conditional types and mapped types so that calling emit('click', payload) is only valid when payload matches the declared event map.
